cvs.text: Full-stack developer experienced in customer support and testing. Proven background in simplifying technical workflows and driving tool adoption by creating accessible documentation and clear failure reports for volunteers. Adept at isolating workflow bottlenecks, mapping edge cases, and updating operational checklists to streamline ongoing releases. Offers strong technical skills in Python, SQL, and APIs, alongside hands-on practice in structuring handover notes that enable service teams to replicate processes independently and maintain data integrity.

Experienced reporting specialist with a strong background in data reconciliation, process mapping, and user guidance. Mapped complex data flows across disparate sources, eliminating duplicated entries by creating mapping tables and cross-departmental checks. Skilled at translating technical processes into clear diagrams and step-by-step guides for finance teams, actively gathering user feedback to add practical examples. Well equipped to document tool rollouts, train service colleagues, and remove repeated manual handover steps.

Experienced with business tools and collaborative application development. Demonstrated success in helping non-technical users adopt new platforms by co-designing interfaces, gathering immediate user feedback, and observing where people get stuck. Proactive in mapping workflows to eliminate duplicate actions and writing clear, practical maintenance guides. Proven ability to organise hands-on practice sessions, refining instructions based on user questions to ensure smooth team handovers.

Experienced operations lead skilled in practical testing, process improvement, and workflow coordination. Replaced chaotic loose-paper ordering with a streamlined, shared system, directly eliminating duplicate steps and training morning service teams on daily upkeep. Proven ability to organise hands-on practice sessions, guiding six new staff members through trial runs using tailored one-page guides with realistic examples. Adept at documenting routines and refining tools based on ongoing operational needs.

Customer support and operational team leader with four years of café management experience. Skilled at mapping routines, establishing practical stock sheets, and guiding new team members through realistic practice sessions. Produces concise, one-page user guides with clear examples of common mistakes, ensuring seamless process handovers and effective tool adoption.

Full-stack software developer with strong analytical and documentation skills. Highly effective at standardising manual workflows and mapping structured procedures to remove ambiguity. Skilled at refining user documentation with real-world examples, supporting reliable operational handovers, and training teams to adopt systematic technical routines.

Experienced in coordinating rental operations, managing case logs, and implementing business tools. Experienced community organiser with a strong track record in practical testing, process mapping, and tool adoption. Skilled at designing practice exercises, observing where users hesitate, and refining step-by-step documentation using real-world questions. Systems and customer support specialist experienced in coordinating technical workflows and user onboarding. Experienced in managing user permissions, testing restoration routines, and producing actionable runbooks. Proven ability to organise hands-on practice sessions for new team members, using simulated failures and trainee questions to clarify instructions, add screenshots, and ensure reliable tool adoption.

Quality assurance and testing specialist experienced with spreadsheet reporting and workflow validation. Resolved duplicate entry issues through targeted checks and authored practical guides for maintenance tasks. Experienced in customer support and business tool development, with a focus on user-centred adoption.
